verdict.rationale: AFK is an automation platform, so white-label embedding is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack only describes a first-party workspace for founders: ops plans, integrations, task graphs and access controls. Nothing mentions embedding, white-labeling, an SDK, or reselling to a developer's own customers, and the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes returned 404.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the automation platform white-label inside my own product for my customers
